sentences.text: The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with the prayer to quash the FIR dated 25.05.2025 giving rise to Case Crime No. 392 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 406, 465, 468, 471 of IPC, Police Station Cantt, Varuna Commissionarate, District Varanasi.

entities.text: Police Station Cantt, Varuna Commissionarate, District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie no offence, complained of, is disclosed against the petitioners and as such, the impugned first information report is liable to be quashed.

5. Per contra, learned AGA and learned counsel for the respondent no. 4 have submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie offence is clearly disclosed against the petitioners, therefore, the impugned first information report can not be quashed in view of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani reported in (2017) 2 SCC 779, Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315 and in a recent decision of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Criminal Appeal No. 843 of 2024, Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others.
6. Having considered the rival submission made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the allegations made in the FIR and the relevant law cited by learned AGA and the fact that impugned first information report discloses cognizable offence against the petitioners, we are of the opinion that the impugned first information report cannot be quashed.

7. The prayer for quashing the impugned first information report is, therefore, refused.
8.

However in case, the petitioners moves an application for anticipatory bail/regular bail before the appropriate court, their bail application shall be considered and disposed of as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.
9. With the aforesaid observations, the instant writ petition is disposed of.
